prs.cluster_pick_reason: #2215 makes the same core regex change as #2214 but goes further: it centralizes the logic in a new normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper (used by buildWellKnownPath) and additionally updates shouldAttemptFallback's root-path check from `pathname === '/'` to `pathname === ''` to stay consistent with the new normalization output. #2214 changes the pathname computation in buildDiscoveryUrls/buildWellKnownPath but leaves shouldAttemptFallback's comparison against the literal '/' unchanged, so under #2214 alone a root path normalized to '' would no longer match that check, causing a redundant fallback discovery attempt on root-like URLs — exactly the regression #2215's title and diff address. #2215 is therefore the more complete fix of the two.

clusters.pick_reason: #1996 implements a dedicated acceptsMediaType() helper that does RFC 7231-style media-range parsing: it splits on ';' to strip parameters, excludes entries with q=0 (explicit non-acceptance), and matches type/subtype including wildcards. #2046 instead uses a plain substring check (acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')), which would incorrectly accept a header like 'application/json;q=0' that explicitly declines JSON, and has no wildcard (application/*, */*) support. #1996's approach handles more of the actual HTTP Accept-header semantics the fix needs to cover.

clusters.pick_reason: #2215 makes the same core regex change as #2214 but goes further: it centralizes the logic in a new normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper (used by buildWellKnownPath) and additionally updates shouldAttemptFallback's root-path check from `pathname === '/'` to `pathname === ''` to stay consistent with the new normalization output. #2214 changes the pathname computation in buildDiscoveryUrls/buildWellKnownPath but leaves shouldAttemptFallback's comparison against the literal '/' unchanged, so under #2214 alone a root path normalized to '' would no longer match that check, causing a redundant fallback discovery attempt on root-like URLs — exactly the regression #2215's title and diff address. #2215 is therefore the more complete fix of the two.

members.title: chore(client): normalize trailing slashes in discovery paths
members.author: raashish1601
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2215: Both PRs fix the same root cause in buildWellKnownPath: the old code only stripped a single trailing slash (`pathname.endsWith('/') ? slice(0,-1) : pathname`), which fails to normalize paths with multiple trailing slashes (e.g. 'foo//') and can produce malformed discovery URLs like '/foo//.well-known/oauth-authorization-server'. Both replace it with the same regex-based fix (`pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '')`) in the identical function, and both also touch buildDiscoveryUrls's analogous pathname-stripping logic.
